title: Manual Research Notebook
summary: Three manual stages with separate materials and rewards.
description: Levels 1, 2 and 3 take 100, 160 and 220 ticks. All three are manual tier 0 stages.
Pay four iron ingots, then four gold ingots, then two emeralds.
Disable inventory contribution to pause without losing progress, or have another team member take over.
Each level has a different reward group; complete several levels before claiming to inspect the stacked reward cards.
